notes: Parameter Page + Read ID + Unique ID + Factory Defect Map form the OTP-style fingerprint of an ONFI device. The Parameter Page CRC + redundancy + Extended Parameter Page provide retrieval-error robustness without host bookkeeping. The Unique ID + complement scheme self-validates via XOR-equals-all-ones.
otp_summary: ONFI defines two factory-programmed (OTP-style) device identification structures plus a factory defect map. (1) Read ID (90h) returns JEDEC manufacturer ID + device ID. (2) Read Parameter Page (ECh) returns 256-byte self-description, 3 redundant copies, CRC-protected. (3) Read Unique ID (EDh) returns 16-byte UID with bit-wise complement, repeated 16 times. (4) Factory defect mapping (Section 3.3) marks bad blocks before shipment.
non_otp_device_state: Other state — Status Register (volatile, per-LUN), Feature Parameter File (programmed by Set Features), page register contents (volatile), array contents (persistent), Volume Address (programmed each boot).

otp_registers.name: Parameter Page (Read Parameter Page ECh)
otp_factory_fields: Features supported / Optional commands supported bitmaps

fields.name: UID complement
fields.description: Bit-wise complement; (UID XOR complement) = all ones if valid.

otp_registers.name: Factory Defect Map (Section 3.3)
otp_factory_fields: First byte of spare area of first/last page = non-FFh.
Erase of marked bad block shall fail (FAIL bit).
